description: A rectangular rug with a traditional design. The central area is a warm, golden yellow with a subtle, textured pattern that mimics wood grain or a brushed fabric. It is bordered by an intricate pattern featuring a deep red inner band and a wider outer band with a repeating motif in cream, red, and black. The outermost edge of the rug appears to be a dark border, possibly black or dark brown. The rug is shown from a slightly elevated, angled perspective, resting on a plain, neutral background. The overall impression is one of classic elegance and warmth, suggesting it would be a focal point in a room.
